# Review Widget. ## An easy solution to show your Google reviews. We have built an easy solution to bring your valuable Google Reviews and Ratings onto any website, shop system, App or into your favourite CMS. Sign up for a free Widget and earn better rankings while improving trust and conversion rates. Framer AI AgentsDesign and publish professional sites with AI. I'm extremely disappointed with this review widget. The product's functionality is severely lacking since I couldn't even connect my account or test it. Despite multiple attempts to reach out, customer support remained unresponsive. This combination of a non-functional product and poor support forces me to look for a better alternative. I give it two stars instead of one, because I like the design and clean looks of the product. just did the anual payment but my account stills appearing as a free plan... so i cant use pro widgets... Hi Product Hunters, this is my very first product launch on this platform! We have launched this very handy solution to bring your valuable Google Ratings onto your website. Try it out and share your feedback! I am looking forward to hear your opinions and hope you like it. Just signed up but there's no confirmation email, my login details are not accepted, there's no link to reset the password and there's no contact information on the website. I've just upgraded to one of you 'paid for' widgets to help display some of the 71 reviews we currently have - it will only display 5. There's no help on your website and no contact details to get help. Bit of a waste of money really... ? makers Cool, congrats on launching! How do I get in touch with them?
